source.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Evernorth Holdings Inc.

confirmed_filing_claims: The prospectus reports approximately 473 million XRP held as of October 9, 2026.
It reports $214.1 million cash raised and used to purchase 84,365,876 XRP at an average price of $2.53657058 in November 2025.
It reports approximately 388,910,554 XRP contributed in kind.
It reports $272.6 million gross cash proceeds at Closing before transaction expenses, including $224.6 million private placement proceeds and $48.0 million trust-account proceeds.
It reports $30 million of convertible senior PIK notes issued on October 12, 2026, with 4% PIK interest and a conditional 8% yield-to-put feature.

It selects Coinbase as the principal market for XRP for financial-reporting purposes and says the selection is based on trading volume/activity, price consistency and regulatory/compliance considerations.
It identifies BitGo as primary custodian and says 100% of XRP was in cold storage as of the prospectus date.
It states yield strategies and DeFi protocol participation commenced following Closing, but gives no specific protocol, deployed amount, wallet or transaction in the reviewed passages.
It states the company may consider XRP-secured financing and may deploy existing XRP holdings in DeFi; these are not proof of a completed XRP-collateral loan.
correction_and_reconciliation: The 388.910554M in-kind total can be bridged from 261.919096M Pubco XRP, 0.2M delayed-funding XRP and 126.791458M Ripple contribution; do not double-count Ripple's contribution.
The $214.05M cash purchase of XRP is part of the broader cash-financing history and must not be counted again on top of the $272.6M gross closing cash proceeds.

The ELOC cover page and detailed financing section state about $76.8M gross and $74.4M estimated net under the cover-price assumption; the summary Use of Proceeds row states $80.7M under the same assumption. Preserve this internal prospectus discrepancy rather than silently choosing one figure.
The ELOC is discretionary: Evernorth may sell some, all or none of the shares. No draw was verified.
The $521,893.50 upfront commitment fee is described as payable and non-refundable; actual payment was not independently verified.
The filing describes BitGo multisignature/HSM controls but does not specify a 2-of-3 threshold in the reviewed custody section.
unresolved_disclosure_tension: The prospectus says 100% of XRP was in cold storage as of the prospectus date, while also saying yield strategies and DeFi protocol participation commenced after Closing.
The reviewed passages do not identify whether the initial yield/DeFi activity involved XRP or other assets, nor its amount, counterparties, protocols, wallets or transaction hashes.
